title: Unveiling the sustainable oxidation approach of homologous alcohols by DPA in a CTAB micellar environment
content:
RSC Sustain., 2025, 3,440-449
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00593G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sandip Kundu, Mandira Mitra, Priya Karmakar, Sk Mehebub Rahaman, Mousumi Layek, Pintu Sar, Bidyut Saha
An aqueous cationic micellar system, formed by the self-assembly of CTAB, provides a green catalytic framework for the efficient oxidation studies by diperiodatoargentate(III) (DPA), facilitating a selective and sustainable transformation.
